important_changes.value: FY2025 total revenue $9,005.7 million versus $7,003.1 million in FY2024; filing reports 28.6% growth.
FY2025 product revenue $7,576.9 million versus $5,884.0 million in FY2024; filing reports 28.8% growth. Service revenue $1,428.8 million versus $1,119.1 million; filing reports 27.7% growth.
Q2 2026 revenue $3,035.7 million versus $2,204.8 million in Q2 2025; earnings release reports 37.7% year-over-year growth and 12.1% sequential growth from Q1 2026.
Q2 2026 product revenue increased 38.8% year over year and H1 product revenue increased 37.7%; service revenue increased 31.3% in Q2 and 29.4% in H1.
Non-cancellable purchase commitments increased from $6.8 billion at 2025-12-31 to $9.7 billion at 2026-06-30; contract-manufacturer deposits increased from $53.0 million to $124.4 million.

important_changes.note: Only the reported period values are compared; no growth rate is calculated.

risk_related_disclosures.value: Two end customers each accounted for more than 10% of annual revenue in each of 2025, 2024 and 2023; 2025 percentages were 16% and 26%. The company states order timing from high-volume customers is unpredictable and concentration can vary with deployment timing, spending cycles and evaluation/qualification periods.
risk_related_disclosures.period: current disclosure in Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, based on annual history

risk_related_disclosures.value: The company states memory and silicon markets have experienced tightening supply conditions due to demand for AI infrastructure and advanced automotive systems; shortages, lead-time increases, allocation reductions or supplier decommitments could affect shipments, revenue and gross margins.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: Risk Factors / supply commitments and shortages
risk_related_disclosures.note: FY2025 Form 10-K already discussed potential tightening in the memory market; the Q2 filing provides updated current wording.

risk_related_disclosures.value: The company relies on three primary contract-manufacturing partners for the vast majority of electronic manufacturing services and relies heavily on a single merchant-silicon supplier for switching chips.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: Concentrations of Business and Credit Risk

risk_related_disclosures.value: Non-cancellable purchase commitments reached $9.7 billion at June 30, 2026, and the company states inventory and commitments are expected to remain elevated and volatile. It warns of excess/obsolete inventory and supplier-liability charges if demand or supplier performance differs from forecasts.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: Note 5 Commitments and Contingencies / MD&A / Risk Factors
risk_related_disclosures.new_vs_10k: quantitative amount updated; underlying risk existed in FY2025 filing

risk_related_disclosures.value: The company states AI networking demand estimates are difficult to forecast; customers may overestimate AI build-out demand and cancel, delay, reduce or modify purchase commitments, and AI Ethernet adoption must compete with InfiniBand and other Ethernet products.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: Risk Factors / rapidly evolving networking market

risk_related_disclosures.value: The earnings release lists escalated or escalating U.S. tariffs and countermeasures, sole/limited-source component risks and key-component supply constraints among forward-looking risks.

governance_and_ownership.value: Jayshree Ullal serves as Chief Executive Officer and Chairperson; the proxy states she is not independent under NYSE listing standards because of her CEO role.
